description: This file contains a function `shapeStackedSeries` that processes raw cost data records, categorizes them by a specified attribute (such as environment or cost category), and structures the data for visualization with Recharts, including zero-filling missing categories.

methods.name: shapeStackedSeries
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a dataset suitable for stacked series visualization, sorting categories and services, and handling unknown labels.
